_about.armor: the game's armour tables (mh4u.py, the MH4U Collection Tracker's decode): 0x28-byte records at [0xf588d8 + 4 * item type] (types 1-5 = chest, arms, waist, legs, head). `m`/`f` = the model each gender draws (record +0 / +2, READ at 0x2f4108); `wear` = record +4: m, f, b = Blademaster, g = Gunner; `pig` = record +0x13, the piece's pigment (READ 0x2f854c); `rar` = rarity; `relic` = record +6 & 0xc0, the relic armour templates. Names: LMD <Slot>Name at the record index. Records named DUMMY and the (None) record 0 are left out.
_about.inner: models drawn for an empty chest / arms / legs slot by the Clothing choice (0x2f4108 falls back to u16 tables 0xf3fc8c / 0xf3fc98 / 0xf3fca4, six entries, indexed by the character's inner-wear byte, char +4 at 0xaf9124). An empty helm or waist draws model 0, which has no file: nothing.
_about.hairFace: per gender, per HELM MODEL (0-582): either one u32 or 28 (one per hairstyle). Low 16 bits: hair parts 0-9 drawn; high 16 bits: face parts 0-6 drawn, and bit 5 of that half also decides whether the Features part is drawn (READ 0xb0ad80 / 0xb08778: table 0x100ca20 m, 0x100d33c f; a value with bit 0x8000 picks row (v & 0x7fff) of 0x100dc58, 28 u32 per row).
_about.features: Features (CharMake: Features, Type 1-12) are face parts 200-211: 0xb08778 shows part 200 + (char +0x3a) - 1 and hides the rest; 0 = none. Their materials take colour type 4.
_about.ht: a helm row's own Blademaster / Gunner type (b, g, or bg for both): its set's, from the records (+0x1c set id, or the helm-to-legs listing index; build_armor.py helm_types): 469 b, 469 g, 32 bg. The Head list filters by it unless Settings -> Equipment treats head armour as both (the game's own rule: wear bits).
_about.colors: each material carries a colour type (materials.json `ct` = .mrl record +0x18 bits 23-30, the same layout as MH3U) that multiplies its albedo map: 1 hair (the hair models), 2 skin (f_skin_BM / m_skin_BM everywhere, and the face), 3 pigment (armour, and the inner wear, so Clothing Color is the inner wear's pigment -- INFERRED from the files, the 4U colour loop is not read), 4 the Features (make000-011), 5 a female face layer (not identified; drawn untinted). `pigments` = the 70 armour pigment colours at 0xf57750 (READ 0x2f854c; melee weapons use 0xf57822 + 3 * record +0x12, gunners 0xf5784f + 3 * record +0x1b). `board` = the game's colour board lyt\lobby\texture\lby_colorscale (core_title.arc), drawn inside its black frame; that the Skin Tone / Hair / Clothing / Feature menus sample it, and their presets, are NOT read -- the viewer uses it as its picker.
_about.poses: the hunter's motion lists (build_poses.py): co_* field, lco_* lobby, pl_make, pl_gc, pl_arena and the weapon classes' wNN, converted per gender onto the inner-wear body, played on that body as a proxy and copied to every piece by bone id. The clips carry no names in the game data.
_about.models: v flipped and ETC1A4 alpha replicated as in the MH3U viewers; `hideIdx` = primitives whose mesh-table row lacks the draw bit (+0 bit 0), the proxy layer. Seven models exist only in romfs/loc/data, with a leading loc\ on their internal path (249, 316, 317, 569, 570, 581, 582); the path builder clears id bit 0x8000 (0xaf7c58), likely that flag -- not traced.
